notes: All images are AI-generated (Higgsfield gpt_image_2_6) and were visually checked for AI artifacts, text, alcohol and pork.
Polaroids are full-bleed photos with no frame; add the white instant-film border in 3D. Max 640 px long side.
Background neon signs in polaroids/hero were softened with a blur so no letter-like shapes remain.
Posters contain no text; text_space hints say where bilingual titles fit best.

Food textures: food/<name>.jpg is the untouched 1024x1024 top-down texture (best for a single dish). For repeating surfaces use tile_file (food/tile/<name>-tile.jpg, 512x512, made seamless with a min-cost seam near the edges). grill-grate-chicken has no tile version: map it once onto the round grill top.
